findings.title: [P3] Preserve the empty-name return contract
findings.body: When `profile.name` is `""` or contains only whitespace, `trim()` produces `""`; the new `||` fallback returns `"Anonymous"`, whereas the previous nullish fallback returned the empty string. If existing callers distinguish a supplied blank name from a missing name, this silently changes their output despite the PR's stated contract-preservation goal. Keep nullish fallback semantics unless this behavior change is intentional and covered by a revised contract/test.
